name: GetSelectedCellRangeFromExcelWorksheet
label: Get Selected Cell Range from Excel Worksheet
description: Retrieves the currently selected cell range in the provided Excel worksheet as first column, first row, last column, and last row indices.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The target Excel worksheet instance to get the selected cell range from.

fields.name: FirstColumnIndex
fields.label: First Column Index
fields.description: Returns the column index (1-based) of the first cell in the selected range.

fields.name: FirstRowIndex
fields.label: First Row Index
fields.description: Returns the row index (1-based) of the first cell in the selected range.

fields.name: LastColumnIndex
fields.label: Last Column Index
fields.description: Returns the column index (1-based) of the last cell in the selected range.

fields.name: LastRowIndex
fields.label: Last Row Index
fields.description: Returns the row index (1-based) of the last cell in the selected range.
